description: Ministry of Sport and Youth Affairs - Amended Extraordinary Gazette No. 2320/58 dated 22nd February 2023 (The Football Federation of Sri Lanka)
categorisation: This gazette content involves an amendment to regulations under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically modifying the text of a previous gazette notification. It deals with legal/regulatory matters - modifying existing regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on the legal framework governing sports administration.
